canonical_rows.text: 定価:本体524円(税別) 雑誌52648-27 メディアファクトリー

IN A WORLD WHERE IT'S NORMAL FOR YOUNG BOYS AND GIRLS TO POSSESS A SPECIAL POWER KNOWN AS "IRIS"... Toru, A BOY WHO "DOESN'T HAVE ANY POWER" AND IS THEREFORE THE TARGET OF CONSTANT BULLYING, LIVED BY HIS MOTTO OF 'MINIMAL EXPOSURE' - TO LIVE WITHOUT STANDING OUT. HOWEVER, AFTER RECEIVING A CERTAIN "CONFESSION" FROM Koyuki, A POPULAR GIRL AT SCHOOL, HIS SUPPOSEDLY PEACEFUL SCHOOL LIFE IS SHATTERED. THUS, HIS MOTTO BEGINS TO SHAKE...! THIS IS AN EXCITING SCHOOL FANTASY STORY THAT STARTS FROM THE MEETING OF A BOY AND GIRL.
蛍たかな +ピロ式 Hotarutakana + Piroshiki
IN CLASS 2-6 WITH Asahi AND Hijiri

HER IRIS ALLOWS HER TO SEE QUALIFIED PEOPLE. WHETHER A PERSON IS QUALIFIED OR NOT IS INDICATED BY AN O OR X ABOVE THEIR HEAD. AS FOR WHAT A PERSON IS QUALIFIED FOR, THAT IS DETERMINED BY WHAT Koyuki IS THINKING OF AT THAT MOMENT.

IN CHAPTER 1, WHILE ELECTING A PRESIDENT, THE REASON SHE ONLY LOOKED AT STUDENTS WAS BECAUSE IN ORDER TO BE QUALIFIED TO BE THE PRESIDENT IN THAT SCHOOL, YOU HAVE TO BE ONE OF THEIR STUDENTS, SO THAT CONDITION WAS ADDED IN AUTOMATICALLY. THAT'S WHY Koyuki WAS QUITE TROUBLED AFTER HAVING LOOKED AT ALMOST ALL THE STUDENTS.

HIS PERSONALITY IS PESSIMISTIC AND RUDE, BOTH SEEM TO HAVE BEEN BORN AS A RESULT OF BULLYING. AS ONE WOULD EXPECT, AFTER HIS EXPERIENCES FROM HIS ELEMENTARY SCHOOL YEARS, THE DEBUT OF HIS "MINIMAL EXPOSURE" POLICY WAS IN HIGH SCHOOL, HOWEVER, IN THE FIRST CHAPTER, THE NATURAL ENEMY OF THAT PEACEFUL SCHOOL LIFE APPEARS... BUT BECAUSE OF HIS ABILITY TO ANALYZE, NO MATTER HOW MUCH HE TRIES, HE CAN'T CUT HIMSELF FREE FROM THIS UNLUCKY QUALITY OR HIS UNFORTUNATE PAST (REFERENCE TO CH4).
HE'S A NEGATIVE CHARACTER WHO YOU WOULDN'T THINK WOULD BE THE PROTAGONIST OF A SHOUNEN MANGA, AND HE WANTS TO CONTINUE DOING THINGS HIS WAY.
THANK YOU VERY MUCH FOR PURCHASING THIS BOOK. THIS IS MY FIRST TANKOUBON... IT WOULD MAKE ME HAPPY IF YOU FEEL EVEN THE SLIGHTEST THING AFTER READING THIS MANGA.
Illustration: 蜜たかみ Design: 清水大輔(designCREST)
I WONDER WHEN IT STARTED, WHEN CHILDREN WERE BORN WITH A POWER CALLED "IRIS" IN THEIR EYES.
THE TYPE OF POWERS WERE VERY EXTENSIVE, "BEING ABE SEE FORMER LIVES", "BEING ABE SEE WHAT'S FOR DINNER".
Toru, IF YOU WHY, THEY THEN WHY, THEY TRY AND "SEE" SOMETHING?
IDIOT/ IT'S IMPOSSIBLE FOR THIS GUY.
THIS POWER THAT ADULTS DIDN'T HAVE SPLIT THE WORLD INTO TWO: "THOSE WHO HAVE IT" AND "THOSE WHO DON'T".
AND BEFORE WE KNEW IT, IT BECAME A CERTIFIED WAY OF CHOOSING WHO WAS TO BE ALIENATED.
CHAPTER I: "THINGS THAT CAN'T BE SEEN"
NOW THAT YOU MENTION IT, I JUST SAW SOMETHING STRANGE WITH MY IRIS.
BECAUSE FOOLISHLY ATTRACTING ATTENTION JUST MAKES MORE ENEMIES.
THAT'S WHY I HIDE IN THE SHADOWS.
ITS ALREADY BECOME A PART OF ME.
OR IT WAS SUPPOSED TO BE...
IPANICKED AND RUSHED OUT OF THE CLASSROOM,
BUT WHAT KIND OF FACE SHOULD I PLUT ON TOMORROW?
COULD I HAVE YOUR REPLY TO WHAT I SAID EARLIER?
AND LOOK FOR THE NEXT STUDENT COUNCIL PRESIDENT. YES! PLEASE GO OUT WITH ME...
MY IRIS ALLOWS ME TO SEE "QUALIFIED PEOPLE".
AND DUE TO THIS, I M'FTEN GIVEN THE JOB OF DECIDING OFFICERS AND OTHER STAFF.

BUT THIS YEAR, I COULDN'T FIND A "QUALIFIED PERSON" TO BE THE STUDENT COUNCIL PRESIDENT, NO MATTER HOW MUCH I TRIED... THIS IS THE FIRST TIME THIS HAS EVER HAPPENED... SO I DECIDED I NEEDED TO FIND SOMEONE TO HELP...
AND THIS "QUALIFIED PERSON" TO DO THAT IS ME, HUH...?
OF COURSE I KNOW THAT TELLING YOU THIS ALL OF A SUDDEN IS A BOTHER...
I DON'T HAVE ANYONE ELSE TO RELY ON.
YOU'RE ALL OVER THE RUMOURS! THE SAY Sasamori-chan CONFESSED TO YOU.
Hijiri... YOU SURE ARE HAPPY EVEN THOUGH IT'S SO EARLY IN THE MORNING...
YOU KNOW? Sasamori Koyuki? SHE'S SWEET, CUTE, AND HAS SUCH A MODEST PERSONALITY.
SHE'S POPULAR ENOUGH TO RANK IN THE TOP 5 OF THE MOST POPULAR GIRLS, AND TO THINK SHE CONFESSED TO YOU.
HMMM. SO THAT GIRL YESTERDAY WAS Sasamori, HUH?
DOES IT REALLY MATTER? SHE'S GOT NOTHING TO DO WITH ME.
SHE CONFESSES AND IT'S GOT NOTHING TO DO WITH YOU...?
THAT'S NOT WHAT HAPPENED YESTERDAY. AND BE- SIDES... ...I TOLD HER ABOUT MY IRIS...
...I SEE. BUT, YOU WERE AT LEAST A LITTLE BIT HAPPY, RIGHT?
...HOW DO YOU EXPECT ME TO ANSWER THAT...?
I'M LOOKING AT THE STUDENTS COMING TO SCHOOL.
WHAT HAPPENED IS A SHAME, BUT I THOUGHT I'D TRY MY BEST WITH WHAT I CAN DO.
...I SEE. WELL, I HOPE YOU FIND IT.
WHAT HAPPENED TO Sasamori-san? WHY IS SHE GETTING SO CLOSE TO HIM?
THE "IRIS ZERO" SNOUL JUST BE LEFT ALONE.
...EHH, THAT WAS A BIT OF A SHOCK.
Stay way from yuki-chan! you're just an Iris Zero
RAISING MY EXPOSURE RATE WILL JUST MAKE MORE ENEMIES.
I SHOULDN'T HANG AROUND SOMEONE WHO STANDS OUT SO MUCH..
I NEED TO PROTECT MY MINIMAL EXPOSURE...
ISN'T SHE THE FIRST ONE SINCE ME...
SHE CONTINUED TO STAND AT THE SCHOOL GATES,
GREETING ME AS IF NOTHING CHANGED.
WHO STILL TALKS TO YOU DESPIE KNOWING THAT YOU DON'T HAVE AN IRIS?
I MEAN TALKING TO ME EVERY MORNING.
DON'T YOU REALIZE IT'S STARTING TO DRAW ATTENTION?
WE "TRIS ZEROS" BEAT UP IF WE STAND OUT.
...STANDING OUT IS A MATTER OF LIFE AND DEATH.
THAT'S WHY MY POLICY IS "MINIMAL EXPOSURE". ...PLEASE DON'T GET IN MY WAY OF THAT...
It'll also cause problems for her if too much attention is drawn to her handing around me...
...I'M SORRY... I DIDN'T THINK THAT I WAS TROUBLING YOU...
IT'S ONLY UNTIL TODAY, SO PLEASE DON'T WORRY ANYMORE.
YES, TODAY IS THE TIME LIMIT.
I GUESS SHE DIDN'T FIND ANYONE, HUH...?
AFTER THIS, I AM GOING TO REPORT THAT I WAS UNABLE TO FIND A QUALIFIED PERSON. BUT...
I TRIED MY BEST WITH WHAT I CAN DO...!
...I GUESS. IT'S BETTER THAN SOMEONE LIKE ME WHO CAN'T SEE ANYTHING.
YOU CAN SEE THE WORLD AS IT IS, WITHOUT ANY KIND OF FILTER, RIGHT?
AH... I'M SORRY, I SAID SOMETHING INSENSITIVE AGAIN, DIDN'T I?
BUT I REALLY WAS A LITTLE JEALOUS... WELL THEN, I NEED TO GO NOW.
I thought I'd try my best and do what I can do.
OKAY THEN, LET'S BEGIN THE STUDENT COUNCIL PRESIDENT ELECTION MEETING.
IT'S JUST Sasamori-chan BRINGING IN WHOEVER SHE "SAW," THEN WE HAVE AN APPOINTMENT CEREMONY, RIGHT?
DON'T YOU THINK SO TOO, Yuuki?
OKAY THEN, PLEASE ANNOUNCE THE "QUALIFIED PERSON".
I TRIED, BUT I COULDN'T FIND ONE...
...EVE THOUGH YOU STOOD AT THE SCHOOL GATES LIKE THAT EVERY DAY?
ARE YOU SURE THAT IT'S "YOU COULDN'T FIND ONE," AND NOT "YOU DIDN'T SEE ONE?"
YOU'VE BEEN GETTING CLOSE TO THAT "TRIS ZERO" RECENTLY, HAVEN'T YOU?
AND "SEEING AN O AND X ABOVE PEOPLE'S HEADS" SEEMS RATHER FAR-FETCHED...
IT'S TRUE THAT I'VE SEEN HER TALKING TO THE "IRIS ZERO"...
... Koyuki ... ISN'T SOME- ONE WHO WOULD LIE...
BUT ITS ALSO TRUE THAT Sasamori-san COULDN'T FIND A QUALIFIED PERSON.
YOU GOT CLOSE TO HIM BECAUSE YOU'RE ALSO AN "TRIS ZERO"...?
WH-WHAT'S WRONG WITH... UMM... YOUR HEAD...
I MEAN, I CAN'T SEE WHAT'S ABOVE MY OWN HEAD, RIGHT?
AH. NOW THAT I THINK ABOUT IT...
Yeah, that has to be it!
I've got no problem with you doing it!
RISKED ALL THAT ATTENTION FOR ME...!
AFTER THAT, THE PRESIDENT WAS UNANI- MOUSLY DECIDED UPON.
AND SO, MY DAYS OF "MINIMAL EXPOSURE"...
That's the first time you returned my greeting! I'm so happy!
BE QUIET. STAY AWAY FROM ME.
...THAT'S RIGHT. ILL BE HAPPY IF THEY RETURN SOON...
I MEAN, YOU STAND OUT TOO MUCH.

Toru's escape is followed by Koyuki catching up to explain her motives.
Koyuki's explanation leads to Toru's rejection based on his lack of Iris.
The rejection scene transitions to the next morning where rumors have spread.
Morning gossip leads to Koyuki appearing at the school gate.
Koyuki's presence at the gate draws the attention and gossip of other students.
Student gossip triggers Toru's internal conflict about his exposure.
Toru's internal struggle is followed by Koyuki's continued daily greetings.
The daily greetings lead to a confrontation in the library.
Toru's warning is met with Koyuki's apology and explanation of the deadline.
The deadline discussion leads directly to the election meeting.
Koyuki's announcement of failure leads to student suspicion and accusations.
Accusations prompt Koyuki to defend herself and reveal Toru's help.
The revelation of Toru's help leads to the students' logical deduction.
The deduction leads to the conclusion that Koyuki is the qualified person.
The election conclusion transitions to the aftermath and Toru's attempt to return to normal.
